raw.cytotoxic_mechanism: Erythromycin is a macrolide antibiotic that inhibits bacterial 50S ribosomal subunit protein synthesis; at 2.5 uM against human cancer cell lines it is expected to be largely inactive because its antibacterial target is absent in human cells, with any weak antiproliferative effect likely reflecting nonspecific macrolide/immunomodulatory or cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress rather than a specific human target.
